title: Triage rules cannot match Prettier's [warn] file line, so a format failure has no valid narrow rule
body: What happened: the format check failed with the log lines '[warn] docs/git-workflow.md' and '[ELIFECYCLE] Command failed with exit code 1.'. The fix step needs a new narrow triage rule. warden done rejected the rule '^\[warn\] docs/git-workflow\.md$' with: rule TR-0003 matches no error line of the failing log. Cause: checkRuleNarrow only tests candidateLines (lines with words like error, fail, missing), and the [warn] line has none. The only candidate line is the ELIFECYCLE line, which pnpm prints for every failed script, so a rule on it would also label real CODE failures (lint, format, typecheck) as OPS. The fixer returned WARDEN_BUG because no narrow rule exists. Expected: a way to give a valid narrow rule for a formatter that names the file on a warn line, for example allow rules to match any line of the failing log, or limit a rule to one check. Steps: edit a tracked file so it fails prettier --check on main, start a run, let the check fail, run the fix step, add a rule on the [warn] line, run warden done. Evidence: 'rule TR-0003 matches no error line of the failing log'. Earlier rules TR-0001 and TR-0002 in this project have the same pattern and could not have matched either.
